slides.title: Dictionary order
slides.scene: List every order of 1 2 3 4 5 the way a dictionary lists words. Find 1 3 5 4 2 in that list. What sits right after it?

blocks.text: The next order changes as little as possible, as far right as possible.

slides.title: LeetCode 31
slides.lead: Rearrange nums into the next bigger order, in place. The biggest order wraps to the smallest.

blocks.text: Up to 100 numbers, O(1) extra memory.

slides.try_first: Write the order right after 1 3 5 4 2 by hand. Which numbers had to change?

slides.title: The tail can't grow
slides.lead: From the right, 5 4 2 falls. A falling tail is already in its biggest order.

blocks.label: 5 4 2 FALLS
blocks.note: No rearranging of 5 4 2 gives a bigger order. Something to its left must change.

slides.title: Find the pivot
slides.lead: Walk left while the numbers fall. The first number smaller than its right neighbour is the pivot.

blocks.label: 3 < 5, SO 3 IS THE PIVOT
blocks.note: The pivot is the rightmost place a bigger order can start.

slides.title: Swap the partner
slides.lead: From the right, find the first number bigger than the pivot, and swap the two.

blocks.text: 4 is the smallest number in the tail that still beats 3.

slides.title: Reverse the tail
slides.lead: The tail 5 3 2 still falls. Reverse it into its smallest order.

blocks.text: Reversing a falling run sorts it, in place.

slides.title: Find the pivot
slides.lead: Walk left past the falling tail.

lines: reverse nums from i + 1 to n - 1

slides.pattern: Find the pivot, swap it with the next bigger number, reverse the tail.

problems.title: Next Greater Element III
problems.note: The same idea on the digits of a number.

blog.summary: The next bigger order of an array: find the pivot, swap it with its partner, reverse the tail.
blog.tested_inputs: hand-picked cases (the biggest order, one number, all equal, repeated numbers) and random arrays of up to 7 numbers from 0 to 5
blog.tested_against: listing every distinct order in sorted order and taking the next one
blog.tested_extra: The walk, the answer and the trap result come from running the code.

caption.first: LeetCode 31 Next Permutation solved with hints: find the pivot, swap it with its partner, reverse the tail.
lines: A falling tail is already its biggest order, so the pivot sits just left of it.
The trap: stop after the swap and 1 3 5 4 2 becomes 1 4 5 3 2, not the next one.
